# `try_validate_utf8`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
try_validate_utf8(str)
```

Returns the original string if `str` is a valid UTF-8 string, otherwise returns NULL.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.0 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_validate_utf8, example 1
> SELECT try_validate_utf8('Spark');
Spark
```

```sql
-- try_validate_utf8, example 2
> SELECT try_validate_utf8(x'61');
a
```

```sql
-- try_validate_utf8, example 3
> SELECT try_validate_utf8(x'80');
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_validate_utf8, example 4
> SELECT try_validate_utf8(x'61C262');
NULL
```
